enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in bed, air conditioner on low for comfortable overnight temperature
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Stretch arms. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to back. Pull blanket up. Adjust head on pillow. Keep eyes closed. Air conditioner remains on low.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and using the toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush. Turn on tap. Apply toothpaste to toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Turn off tap. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and toasting bread
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread and butter. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Pour boiled water into cup. Take toast from toaster. Spread butter. Eat breakfast and drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up the home workstation on the computer, checking phone messages, and reviewing the day's telehealth appointment list
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit at desk. Press computer power button. Type password. Open telehealth application. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Read messages. Put down phone. Open appointment schedule. Review appointments.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home as a health care professional, conducting telehealth consultations and updating patient records on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open patient file. Start video call. Speak with patient. Listen to patient. Take notes. End call. Update patient records. Type notes. Save file. Open next patient file. Start video call. Speak with patient. Take notes. End call. Update patient records. Save file. Drink water. Adjust headset. Continue with next patient.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing a quick lunch with the induction cooker and eating at the kitchen counter
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add ingredients. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Transfer food to plate. Sit at counter. Eat lunch.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a break, resting on the sofa and reading public-health updates on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open news app. Scroll through updates. Read article. Scroll to next article. Read article. Put down phone. Lean back on sofa. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work-from-home telehealth sessions and following up on patient care plans via the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open patient care plan. Review plan. Start video call. Speak with patient. Discuss care plan. Take notes. End call. Update care plan on computer. Type notes. Save file. Open next patient care plan. Review plan. Start video call. Speak with patient. Take notes. End call. Update care plan. Save file.

enriched_activities.activity: Freshening up after the workday, loading and starting the washing machine with used clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Wash hands. Wash face. Dry face. Open washing machine. Load clothes. Close door. Add detergent. Press start. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying up and vacuuming the living room floor
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up items from floor. Place items on table. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Push vacuum across floor. Pull vacuum back. Move around furniture. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Put away vacuum.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner using the induction cooker and range hood, then eating the meal
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on range hood. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add ingredients. Stir. Add seasoning. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Turn off range hood. Transfer food to plate. Carry plate to table. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table, loading the dishwasher, and wiping down the countertops
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from table. Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Place plates in dishwasher. Pick up glasses. Place in dishwasher. Pick up utensils. Place in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Press start. Wipe countertops with sponge.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV and browsing the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media. Scroll. Read posts. Put down phone. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Scroll. Put down phone. Lean back.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a warm shower and hanging clothes in the dryer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body with soap and water. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel. Open dryer. Place clothes in dryer. Close dryer. Press start.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in bed, turning on the desk lamp and reading, dimming the light and switching on the fan for air circulation
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Lie on bed. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Close book. Put down book. Dim light. Turn on fan.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the air conditioner set to a comfortable overnight temperature
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Stretch arms. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to back. Pull blanket up. Adjust head on pillow. Keep eyes closed. Air conditioner runs.
